## About Me

I design and build software systems at the intersection of agriculture, supply chain traceability, and mobile tech.

My work focuses on architecting offline-first mobile solutions, secure sync protocols, and developer-friendly tooling.

## Current Focus

| Area | What I am exploring |
| --- | --- |
| **AgriTech Platforms** | Designing transaction and quota management systems for sustainable supply chains. |
| **Offline-First Mobile** | Developing robust data synchronization architectures for Android and mobile devices. |
| **Data Security** | Implementing secure local database encryption (AES-256) and API key protections. |

## Featured Work

| Project | Focus | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [**GeoHarvest App**](https://github.com/chandrasyahputra898/Chandra) | Traceability & Transactions | Mobile and web client platforms for managing supply chain logistics, quota tracking, and transactions. |

## Research Direction

I am interested in building resilient data sync mechanisms and secure audit logs that allow agricultural transactions to be recorded reliably, even in remote or low-connectivity environments.

## Tech Stack

`TypeScript` · `React Native` · `Node.js` · `Python` · `PostgreSQL` · `SQLite` · `AES-256` · `Docker`
